    Terms of use

    The short version: look things up, compare and share links as much as you like. Don't copy our database with scripts, and don't republish it.

    By using youfundceo.com you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the site.

    Personal, non-commercial use

    You may use the site to look up and compare subscription prices for yourself. You may share links to our pages, and quote a few prices in a post, article or conversation if you link to the page they came from.

    The embed cards (“Embed on your site” on service pages) are free to use on any website as they are, as long as the “Data: YouFundCEO” link stays visible.

    Anything else, such as using our prices in a product, a service, a paid report or a business, needs our written permission first. Get in touch if you'd like to work with our data.

    No automated collection

    You may not, yourself or through anyone else:

    • collect data from the site with scrapers, crawlers, bots, scripts, headless browsers or any other automated means;
    • download prices, history or other data in bulk, or call the site's data endpoints outside our pages;
    • get around rate limits, blocks or other measures that protect the site;
    • use our data to train or improve machine learning or AI models.

    Search engines may index our pages as our robots.txt allows. We may block anyone who breaks these rules, without notice.

    Don't republish the database

    Each price is a public fact, but our collection is our work: which services and countries we cover, how we verify each price, the history we keep, and the notes on countries we couldn't verify. You may not copy, republish, sell or redistribute that collection or a substantial part of it, in any form, or use it to build a competing database.

    The data is offered as is

    Prices come from each service's official pricing pages. Services change prices without notice, and taxes, fees, promotions and payment method can change what you pay. We work hard to be accurate, but we don't guarantee that anything here is complete, correct or up to date. Always check the official page before you pay.

    Everything here is information, not financial, legal or tax advice. As far as the law allows, we aren't liable for any loss that comes from using the site or relying on its data. See also the disclaimer.

    Names and logos

    Service names and logos belong to their owners. We use them only to show which service a price is for. We're not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any of them.

    Changes

    We may update these terms. The version on this page is the one that applies. Questions? Contact us.
